Now I understand the presentation structure. There are 3 slides about Q4 sales results. Let me apply the "Modern Minimalist" theme (a professional choice for sales presentations) to the deck:

```bash
python3 << 'EOF'
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

# Load the Modern Minimalist theme
theme = {
    'primary': '#2c3e50',
    'secondary': '#7f8c8d',
    'accent': '#3498db',
    'background': '#ffffff',
    'text': '#34495e',
    'header_font': 'Roboto',
    'body_font': 'Lato'
}

prs = Presentation('/workspace/sales_presentation.pptx')

# Apply theme to all slides
for slide in prs.slides:
    # Set background color
    if slide.background:
        slide.background.fill.solid()
        slide.background.fill fg_color.rgb = theme['background']
    
    # Apply fonts and colors to shapes
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if hasattr(shape, "text") and shape.text.strip():
            # Get text parts (title and body)
            text_parts = shape.text.split('\n')
            
            # First line is title, rest is body
            if len(text_parts) > 1:
                # Title formatting
                title = text_parts[0]
                body = '\n'.join(text_parts[1:])
                
                # Set title font and color
                if hasattr(shape, 'title'):
                    shape.title.font.name = theme['header_font']
                    shape.title.font.size = Pt(36)
                    shape.title.font.color.rgb = theme['primary']
                    shape.title.font.bold = True
                    
                # Set body text
                if hasattr(shape, 'text'):
                    # We need to set the text and formatting
                    shape.text = shape.title.text + '\n' + body
                    if hasattr(shape, 'text_frame'):
                        tf = shape.text_frame
                        for p in tf.paragraphs:
                            p.font.name = theme['body_font']
                            p.font.size = Pt(24)
                            p.font.color.rgb = theme['text']
                            p.font.lspacing = 10
                else:
                    shape.text = title
                    shape.font.name = theme['header_font']
                    shape.font.size = Pt(36)
                    shape.font.color.rgb = theme['primary']
                    shape.font.bold = True
                    shape.font.name = theme['body_font']
                    shape.font.size = Pt(24)
                    shape.font.color.rgb = theme['text']

# Save with new theme name
prs.save('/workspace/sales_presentation_themed.pptx')
print("Successfully applied Modern Minimalist theme!")
print(f"Output saved to: /workspace/sales_presentation_themed.pptx")
EOF
```

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

# Load the Modern Minimalist theme

    'primary': '#2c3e50',
    'secondary': '#7f8c8d',
    'accent': '#3498db',
    'background': '#ffffff',
    'text': '#34495e',
    'header_font': 'Roboto',
    'body_font': 'Lato'
}

prs = Presentation('/workspace/sales_presentation.pptx')

# Apply theme to all slides
for slide in prs.slides:
    # Set background color
    slide.background.fill.solid()
    slide.background.fill.fg_color.rgb = theme['background']
    
    # Apply fonts and colors to shapes
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if hasattr(shape, "text") and shape.text.strip():
            # Get text parts (title and body)
            text_parts = shape.text.split('\n')
            
            # First line is title, rest is body
            if len(text_parts) > 1:
                # Title formatting
                title = text_parts[0]
                body = '\n'.join(text_parts[1:])
                
                # Set body text with formatting
                if hasattr(shape, 'text_frame'):
                    tf = shape.text_frame
                    tf.clear()
                    
                    # Add title paragraph
                    title_para = tf.add_paragraph()
                    title_para.text = title
                    title_para.font.name = theme['header_font']
                    title_para.font.size = Pt(36)
                    title_para.font.color.rgb = theme['primary']
                    title_para.font.bold = True
                    title_para.space_after = Pt(12)
                    
                    # Add body paragraphs
                    for line in body.split('\n'):
                        if line.strip():
                            body_para = tf.add_paragraph()
                            body_para.text = line
                            body_para.font.name = theme['body_font']
                            body_para.font.size = Pt(24)
                            body_para.font.color.rgb = theme['text']
                            body_para.space_after = Pt(8)
                else:
                    shape.text = shape.text
                    shape.font.name = theme['body_font']
                    shape.font.size = Pt(24)
                    shape.font.color.rgb = theme['text']

# Save with new theme name
prs.save('/workspace/sales_presentation_themed.pptx')
print("Successfully applied Modern Minimalist theme!")
print(f"Output saved to: /workspace/sales_presentation_themed.pptx")
EOF
